name: Studies and Reviews
author: NoahGarrf
description:
Standalone version of an existing feature from my LARP Builder mod. The idea being users (YOU) can pay a little bit of money to figure out how many riders your blueprint will add to the system. Basically a simple usecase if you have 3 saved blueprints of the same alignments with 1 minor change and you can study each and compare to see which one gets the most riders before building instead of guessing which is best.

The mod also is kinda smart, it has a calibration function where 2 day ticks it will compare its estimated ridership with actual ridership and use the difference to calibrate the next study, the more studies you do and build the more accurate the mod gets. However in my experience its pretty much 1:1 from the get go in grid cities like NY, cities like Houston can start off wrong but get ~1:1 accurate after 2 or 3 blueprint study cycles.
